migration.description: Add the private shared-draft projection and durable mutation ledger for Session-scoped multi-client editing.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one execution-domain candidate following migration 00012; draft reads and writes remain private to the authenticated owner and are never submission side effects.

compatibility_assessment.reason: The public contract adds additive Session draft operations and the database adds owner-scoped tables. Existing Sessions remain readable as empty revision-zero drafts until their first update; no existing rows are rewritten or backfilled.

durable_state.description: conversation_drafts stores the current private projection. conversation_draft_mutations retains bounded mutation metadata for accepted replacements and versioned consume operations so current-mutation retries can be recognized and older mutation IDs rejected as stale without retaining superseded draft text or content fingerprints.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL tables managed by embedded Goose migration 00013. A Session row lock serializes accepted updates and version increments; owner_user_id is retained on both projection and ledger for defense-in-depth privacy checks. The ledger stores mutation metadata only, never historical draft bodies or content-derived fingerprints.
durable_state.retention_policy: Mutation metadata is retained for the lifetime of the Session so current-mutation retries can be recognized and older mutation IDs rejected as stale. Each accepted mutation contributes one bounded metadata row; draft bodies are retained only in the current owner-scoped projection and are replaced or cleared by later revisions. Session/database retention and capacity governance remain the owner of eventual lifecycle cleanup.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Phase-one execution-domain candidate containing migrations 00009 through 00012.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Phase-one private shared-draft candidate after migration 00013.
source_compatibility_range.compatibility_boundary: Older candidates ignore the additive draft tables; only a draft-capable candidate exposes or consumes the new state.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create the owner-scoped current projection, mutation ledger and client-sequence uniqueness index. No existing data is rewritten.

progress_signals: Migration history records 00013 only after both tables and both indexes commit.
A draft update increments one Session-scoped revision and writes its mutation ledger row in the same transaction.
A conditional consume either clears the exact submitted revision or leaves a newer revision untouched.
pause_points: Before applying 00013, verify the candidate source identity and PostgreSQL migration lock availability.
After the migration commits and before enabling draft adapters, verify the owner and sequence constraints.

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: forward-repair-by-a-new-program-version; the additive tables can remain unused while adapters are disabled

required_test_evidence: A new candidate reads Sessions from the 00012 state as empty revision-zero drafts without rewriting historical rows.

Accepted updates are owner-scoped, UTF-8 and size bounded, ordered by the Session lock/commit sequence, durable under retries, and retain mutation metadata rather than superseded draft bodies or content-derived fingerprints.

A repeated current mutation ID with the original content is idempotent, a current mutation ID with different content is rejected, an older mutation ID is rejected as stale, a reused client sequence is rejected, and a cross-owner read or write cannot access the projection.
Conditional consume clears only the expected revision and preserves a newer update; retries of the same command remain idempotent.
The migration is additive and re-entry does not rewrite existing execution state.
